title: Grain Clerk Training Note: Which Load-Outs Count as Bushels Moved Onto a Marketing Contract
content:
A member may hold bushels in store under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements and move some of them onto their marketing business under Grain Marketing Contracts. Which load-outs standing on the storage account count as bushels moved onto the contract depends on what remains in store.

**Where a load-out stands on the member's storage account within the three months before the balance is struck and bushels of the contract's commodity remain in store**, only the load-outs recorded in those three months are counted as bushels moved onto the marketing business.

**Where no bushels of the contract's commodity remain in store**, no load-out is counted at all, since bushels that have left the account cannot be shown to have gone onto this contract.

**Where neither of those holds** — that is, where bushels of the commodity remain in store but no load-out stands within those three months — every load-out recorded on the storage account in the twelve months before the balance is struck is counted.

## The three cases side by side

| Bushels of the contract's commodity remaining in store | A load-out inside the three months before the balance is struck | Load-outs counted |
|---|---|---|
| Some remain | Yes | only those recorded in those three months |
| Some remain | No | every one recorded in the twelve months before the balance is struck |
| None remain | Yes | none at all |
| None remain | No | none at all |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A member's storage account under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements shows a load-out of 600 bushels two months ago and a further load-out of 900 bushels nine months ago, with bushels of the contract's commodity still standing in store. Only the 600 bushels of the recent load-out are counted. Were the account empty of that commodity, neither load-out would be counted. Were the only load-out the one nine months ago, with bushels still in store, the twelve-month reach would apply and those 900 bushels would be counted.
